steps.title: Charge
steps.imageAlt: G Pen Dash II with USB-C cable

bullets.text: Plug **any USB-C cable** into the port on the device.
Give it a full charge before first use.

steps.title: Load
steps.imageAlt: Dash II mouthpiece removed, chamber open for loading

bullets.text: **Remove the mouthpiece** to access the chamber.
**Fully load** the chamber with dry material.
**Pack lightly** with the included pick tool — do not overpack.

note.text: A proper pack allows airflow. Overpacking restricts draws and reduces vapor quality.

steps.title: Activate
steps.imageAlt: Dash II power button and temperature controls

note.text: Lower temperatures preserve flavor. Higher temperatures produce bigger clouds.

steps.title: Clean
steps.imageAlt: Cleaning the Dash II mouthpiece filter screen and bowl

bullets.text: Clean the **mouthpiece filter screen & bowl** after every use with the pick tool.
**Deep clean:** remove the mouthpiece insert, clean with **isopropyl alcohol (IPA)**.
Let all parts **dry completely** before reassembling.

note.text: **Never soak the battery** in alcohol or any liquid.

specs.label: Session mode
specs.value: Double-tap to start / cancel · 2 min / 3 min / 4 min

faq.question: How do I turn it on?
faq.answer: Hold the main button for 3 seconds. The device will vibrate and the display will turn on, indicating it is powered up and ready.

faq.question: How do I start a session?
faq.answer: Once the device is on and at your desired temperature, double-tap the button within 2 seconds to start a session. Double-tap again anytime to cancel it early.

faq.question: My vapor tastes burnt — what's wrong?
faq.answer: You may have the temperature too high, or the bowl may need cleaning. Try a lower temperature setting and clean the screen and bowl with the pick tool after each session.

faq.question: How tight should I pack the chamber?
faq.answer: Pack firmly enough that material won't fall out but loose enough that you can draw air through easily. Overpacking restricts airflow and reduces vapor production.

faq.question: How do I deep clean the mouthpiece?
faq.answer: Remove the mouthpiece insert and soak or wipe it with isopropyl alcohol. Let it dry completely before reassembling and using the device.

faq.question: What does the warranty cover?
faq.answer: The Dash II carries a limited warranty. Register your device and read the full terms on gpen.com, or contact support with your order details.
